owner_requirements: gb_feedback_2045: diagnose why the bonus over-fires (23/24) and preregister v0.0.25 with ONE lever; tag only on a preregistered PASS
gb_feedback_1950: a smoke test showing the lever fires and >= 90% valid before the full run; PRs off main; nice 19; launch gated on load < 70 in one command
question: Does adding a graded penalty for non-striking contact before the opponent's fall (the contact that leaves knockdowns unresolved) to the v0.0.24 recipe remove blocked games, passing the v0.0.13 hard gate and monotonicity while keeping the primary vs frozen v0.0.19?
lever: ONE change from v0.0.24: fitness -= 0.5 * min(1, contact_ticks / 500), contact_ticks = non-striking inter-athlete contact ticks (ContactClassifier.blocking) up to the opponent's first fall (motor_gate.trial). Bonus (valid_knocked_down), start policy (v0.0.22 final_params), training opponent (frozen v0.0.19), model, ES, reset and ending v2 unchanged.
why_this_lever: cycle-0037 diagnosis: the binary valid-knockdown bonus is SATURATED at the v0.0.22 base (23/24 vs v0.0.19 in the v0.0.24 smoke; 22/24 vs v0.0.13 on non-protocol design seeds), so it gives ES no ranking signal; a 'train vs v0.0.13' draft was therefore discarded unregistered. Contact ticks before the opponent's fall vary widely across base trials (design seeds: vs v0.0.19 median 376, IQR 298-437; vs v0.0.13 median 66, IQR 54-88; never 0), and contact before the fall is what leaves a knockdown unresolved (blocked).
classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN, run as 16 + 32 iterations on one generator (identical to one 48-iteration call) so the @16 checkpoint is kept

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate vs gen4, reported (not gating)

primary.name: vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 28000-28023 (48 games), checked in order

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.25 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. VALIDITY: valid games (selfplay.valid_result) >= 40/48, else verdict VALIDITY_FAILED (fail loud: non-zero exit, later criteria not evaluated)
2. DECISIVENESS: decisive games (valid wins + valid losses, i.e. not draws) >= 24/48, else verdict DECISIVE_FAILED (fail loud)
3. (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 and (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit; else CRITERION_NOT_MET; both pass -> PRIMARY_PASSED

hard_gate_v0013.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 (punch, punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)), eval noise 0.05

monotonicity.pass: for each: valid >= 40/48 first, then Wilson 95% lower bound of the more-trained side's win rate over valid games > 0.55 (same rule as the v0.0.21 addendum)

level_up: tag v0.0.25 iff the smoke gate passed AND primary verdict PRIMARY_PASSED AND hard_gate_v0013 passes AND both monotonicity matchups pass

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 29000-29023
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.training: per-iteration stand time, knockdown_share, valid_knockdown_share, mean_contact_ticks
secondary_reported_not_gating.reporting: every head-to-head split by the stronger side's seat with wins / losses / draws / no-contests / blocked / engine faults counted separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.blocked_diagnosis: for every blocked game in the primary, hard gate and monotonicity: count; the per-seat split shows them separately

red_team_notes: the contact penalty also counts guard and glove-on-non-target contact (all non-striking contact), not only body-on-body; it may teach the policy to back away rather than box
the training opponent is still v0.0.19 while the hard gate is vs v0.0.13 (contact there is ~6x lower)
the smoke validity check measures the starting policy (cycle-0036); it now uses 48 games
no game has been played on seeds 27000-30023; design checks used seeds 99700-99823
pre_declared_readings: SMOKE_FAILED: report which check; no full run
contact falls but knockdowns vanish (VALIDITY/DECISIVE_FAILED): the penalty taught avoidance, not clean boxing; next lever: penalise contact only in the 0.5 s before the fall
hard gate still fails on blocked games vs v0.0.13: next lever: alternate both training opponents

smoke_gate.when: first stage of the probe, before any training
smoke_gate.policy: the v0.0.22 base policy (group_pd, eval noise 0.05)
smoke_gate.opponent: frozen v0.0.19 (the training and primary opponent)

bonus_check.what: motor_gate.trial of the v0.0.22 base vs frozen v0.0.19 (the exact path the fitness reads)
bonus_check.why: the lever must carry signal: its term must be nonzero in >= 10% of base trials and vary by >= 0.05 across them; the valid-knockdown share is reported

validity_check.what: selfplay.play_game head-to-head of the v0.0.22 base vs frozen v0.0.19 under ReferenceEndingEnv (0.5 m, anti-stalling, ending v2)
validity_check.sides: both (48 games; v0.0.24 used 12, whose 95% interval spans ~0.55-0.95)

smoke_gate.on_fail: SMOKE_FAILED if either check fails: non-zero exit, no training, no gates; both censuses saved
